time.unit: seconds since the start of each recording
time.trimming: The dataset authors removed 30 s from the start and end of each 11 min recording. Files are exactly 600 s, so no further trimming is applied.

reset_rule: A backward time step starts a new segment. Rows are never sorted.
duplicate_timestamp_rule: Within a segment keep the first row for a repeated timestamp and log whether the values differed.
interpolation: Linear, inside each segment only. No extrapolation and no filling across segment boundaries.
